guide.verdict: Public multi-customer app, Xero certification (app review).

composio.note: Xero is in Composio's bring-your-own-app list. Create a custom auth config with your own client ID and secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into your Xero app.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Xero has no Composio-managed app, so you must register your own Xero app and give Composio its client ID and secret.
reasons: No managed app exists for Xero in Composio
Xero API access needs OAuth 2.0 client credentials
Your own app is needed for your branding on the consent screen

scenarios.label: Public multi-customer app, Xero certification
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your AI agent connects many customers' Xero organisations and you want certification and App Store listing.

hands_on.estimate: 1-2 weeks of work, excluding recruiting beta customers
hands_on.basis: c11 (assessment about 5 working days) plus estimated setup steps; beta recruiting time not measured

waiting.basis: No verified source backs this timeline (the agent's estimate was "5-10 working days (about 1-2 weeks) for security review, plus follow-up questions").

scenarios.approval: Xero security team reviews a security assessment before certification and listing. Advanced assessment applies above 1,000 connections. Whether unlisted apps may serve outside customers is not confirmed.
extras: 10 beta customers before submitting the certification application
Advanced security assessment at 1,000 or more connections
Security assessment must be passed every year

modifiers.note: 10 beta customers before submitting the certification application
Advanced security assessment at 1,000 or more connections

prerequisites.title: Xero account and demo company
prerequisites.detail: Sign up for a free Xero account. You can develop against the demo company or a trial organisation at no cost.

prerequisites.title: 10 beta customers
prerequisites.detail: You must onboard 10 beta customers before submitting for certification. They must not be demo companies and must have had API calls in the last 30 days.

steps.title: Create Xero account and demo company
steps.detail: Sign up for a free Xero account and use the demo company for development.
steps.done_when: You can log in to the Xero developer portal.

steps.title: Register your app in the Xero portal
steps.detail: Register an OAuth 2.0 app to get a client ID and client secret.
steps.done_when: You hold a client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config for the xero toolkit via Composio's API using your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and shows a redirect URI.

steps.title: Add Composio redirect URI to Xero app
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into your Xero app settings.
steps.done_when: A test connection completes against the demo company.

steps.title: Choose granular scopes and draft justifications
steps.detail: Pick the narrowest granular scopes, such as accounting.invoices, and draft a justification for each.
steps.done_when: Scope list and justifications are ready.

steps.title: Build Sign Up with Xero and connection management
steps.detail: Implement Sign Up with Xero, which is required for listing, and use the exact button labels. Connection management is a common checkpoint failure.
steps.done_when: The app passes Xero's checkpoint list.

steps.title: Onboard 10 beta customers
steps.detail: Recruit real customer organisations to connect and use the app before submitting.
steps.done_when: 10 organisations have connected and made API calls.

steps.title: Prepare security assessment answers
steps.detail: Draft answers covering authentication, encryption and audit logging for your review.

steps.title: Submit assessment and certification application
steps.detail: Review the draft answers, submit them and the certification application from the developer centre.

steps.title: Xero reviews your assessment
steps.detail: Xero emails whether you passed and may ask extra questions.
steps.done_when: You receive a pass email or a remediation report.

steps.title: Fix findings if you got a remediation report
steps.detail: Complete the remediation work and resubmit.

traps.title: Beta customer requirement blocks submission
traps.detail: One launch stalled until its customer-trial requirement was met. Start recruiting beta customers early.

traps.title: Certification checkpoints trip up teams
traps.detail: Developers report nine checkpoints. Wrong Sign Up/Sign In button labels cause delays, and connection management catches most teams.

traps.title: Rate limits are fixed per tenant
traps.detail: Limits are 5 concurrent calls, 60 per minute and 5,000 per day per organisation, with 10,000 per minute across all tenants. They are the same for all apps, and excess calls get HTTP 429.

traps.title: Scope changes need fresh user consent
traps.detail: Xero is moving from broad to granular scopes. Users must explicitly consent to the new set.

blockers.symptom: Xero asks for a security assessment or remediation report
blockers.what_it_means: Xero's security team found gaps or needs more detail before passing you.
blockers.what_to_do: Complete the remediation work and resubmit.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft remediation plans and evidence write-ups.

blockers.what_it_means: The 10 beta customer requirement is probably not yet met.
blockers.what_to_do: Onboard more real customer organisations with recent API calls.

open_questions: What can an uncertified app do for outside customers, and is there a connection cap? Check Xero developer docs or ask Xero developer support.
Which scopes, if any, trigger extra review? The granular scopes page does not say; ask Xero developer support.
Does Xero require partner acceptance beyond the security assessment? Check the App Store partner programme page or ask support.
Does a customer's Xero admin need to approve the app? Not found; test with a real organisation.
Does Xero verify redirect-URI domains? Not found; test the Composio callback in your Xero app.

claims.text: The Xero API uses OAuth 2.0, so you must register your app to get a client ID and client secret.
claims.label: provider_docs
claims.quote: The Xero API does not support basic API Key authentication. Our API uses OAuth 2.0 which means you need to  register your app  to get a client id and client secret which you use to access the API.

claims.text: OAuth 2.0 is required for all new Xero integrations; OAuth 1.0a is being deprecated.
claims.label: provider_docs
claims.quote: We currently support OAuth 1.0a and OAuth 2.0. However, OAuth 1.0a is in the process of being deprecated and OAuth 2.0 is required for all new integrations.
